facts.fact: RSTP's National Data Centre was operating as of 2026-09-24 and RSTP said it provides IT solutions to both public and private sectors, as reported by the Times of Eswatini; it was hit by an incident disrupting at least 12 government services.
Times of Eswatini reports the National Data Centre is run by the Royal Science and Technology Park (RSTP), which it describes as a parastatal under the Ministry of ICT.

An incident at the RSTP-run National Data Centre disrupted at least 12 government digital services (Government in Your Hand app, e-Visa, company registration, government website, IFMIS, Elderly Grant payment, Deeds Registration and others), indicating state systems are hosted there; RSTP first acknowledged the outage on 2026-09-18.

note: carried from datacentres; no document opened
